newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba says 1995 mark appreciation now corrected.
newsitem.headline: Buba says 1995 mark appreciation now corrected.

text.p: Exchange rate levels broadly reflect economic fundamentals and the mark appears to have completely corrected from a prolonged period of strength, the Bundesbank said in its monthly report for December.
"Unlike 1995, exchange rate levels now to a large degree correspond to economic fundamentals," the central bank said.
The German mark, which strengthened last year causing problems for exporters, meanwhile has reached more appropriate levels, the Bundesbank added.
The report said that compared to an average of 18 important currencies, with foreign value of the mark is about the same level as it was in 1994.
"The strong appreciation of the mark has since completely corrected," the Bundesbank said.

In reference to exchange value of the mark to the dollar, it said the "largely relaxed" economic growth in the United States and Germany's monetary policy had pushed hopes of interest rate movements into the background.
